company.title: Tell us about {company}
company.intro: We read your website and documents and build a profile of the company that every tool here uses: chat answers, proposals, outreach. What you write here is kept as your own facts; you can change any of it later in Settings › Company.
company.homepageIsSource: Your homepage is already a source; it is not imported again.
company.homepageImport: We import your homepage as a source, so the profile can quote it.
company.descriptionPlaceholder: A sentence or two: what you offer and to whom.
company.idea: What’s the idea you’re working on?
company.ideaPlaceholder: What you're building, for whom, and why now.

documents.title: Add documents about the company
documents.intro: A pitch deck, one-pager, plan, past proposal or report. Only documents written by or about {company} count toward its profile; anything else you add later is kept for search and set aside, and each source says why.
documents.formats: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Markdown or text

understood.title: Here's what we understood so far
understood.reading: Your sources are being read now. This page updates as they are, and you can leave at any time: the profile keeps building.
understood.ready: This is the profile of {company} as your sources and answers stand. Add documents any time and it grows.
understood.importFailedKept: {message}. It stays your website; change it in Settings › Company.
understood.profileFailed: The profile could not be built. Your answers and sources are kept; rebuild it from the company profile.
understood.profileFailedReason: The profile could not be built: {reason} Your answers and sources are kept; rebuild it from the company profile.
understood.profileFailedReasonStop: The profile could not be built: {reason}. Your answers and sources are kept; rebuild it from the company profile.
understood.noSummary: No summary yet. It is written from your sources: add your website or a document about the company.
understood.progress: {read} of {total} sources read. {facts, plural, one {# fact} other {# facts}} so far.
understood.progressNoSources: {facts, plural, one {# fact} other {# facts}} so far.

ask.title: Ask your sources
ask.text: Answers cite the exact passage they come from.

proposal.title: Write a proposal
proposal.text: Drafts grant and funding applications from the profile.

buyers.title: Find buyers
buyers.text: Searches for companies that match what you sell.

readOnly.title: Setting up {company}
readOnly.body: A workspace admin tells the profile about the company: its website, what it does and the documents about it. You can read the profile and ask questions of everything in the workspace.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.bodySuspended: An admin of {workspace} has paused your access. You stay a member, but nothing opens until they reinstate you.
pending.body: An admin of {workspace} has to confirm you before anything opens. You'll get an email as soon as they do.
pending.stuck: Stuck? Ask the person who invited you, or <link>contact support</link>.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.descriptionMail: Questions, feedback, or bug reports. Your message opens in your mail client.
contact.noAddress: This instance has no support address configured. Whoever operates it can set SUPPORT_CONTACT_EMAIL to receive messages here.
contact.issueTracker: For problems with Launchstack itself, open an issue on <link>the issue tracker</link>.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what's on your mind…
contact.opensIn: Opens in your mail client, addressed to {email}.

rows.communityHint: Ask other people running this instance.
rows.responseTimeHint: Set by whoever operates this instance.
rows.softwareHint: Bugs and feature requests for the software.

report.inMessage: These details are already in your message, so whoever runs this instance can find the error in its logs.
